lines.name: Rivals & Reach
lines.bar: Rivals read the player's ambition through the fog: on Powers/Dossier with a rival selected, a line owned by that rival states whether it sees the player's family (intel tier ≥ 2), never naming the family; the AI courts a rival's opposing member as a lever when it holds intel tier ≥ 2 on that house and leaves a beat naming the member; a lever pulled by a rival is visible on the player's House/Court page
